basic_info.description: Spectacular Edwardian home built in 1913, blending modern upgrades with timeless period charm. Original details such as a wood-burning fireplace, rich wood paneling, and elegant hardwood floors showcase the character of the era while offering comfort and warmth. With ample space for expansion below, a large backyard and ocean to Golden Gate Bridge to Downtown views, 936 Kirkham Street is a neighborhood gem with tremendous opportunity to expand further or live in it as it is. Don't miss the chance to experience its beauty!
